# Vehicle turret controls

*Source: every `WDVehicleWeaponDataAsset` and every `DT_VehicleCrosshair_*` table under `Plugins/GameFeatures/Vehicles`. Generated by [`_tools/vehicle_round85_tables.py`](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/_tools/vehicle_round85_tables.py). Evidence and status: [round 85 vehicles](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/docs/evidence/round85-veh.md).*

Each vehicle weapon is a `WDVehicleWeaponDataAsset` (`W_*`) that holds the weapon tag, the turret mesh, the muzzle sockets, the aim-rotation settings and the camera for each aim state. The damage and ballistics are on the `WE_*` weapon-extension assets, which are covered in [Vehicle weapons and effects](Wardogs_VehicleWeaponsEffects_v1.md). `-` means the asset does not set the field.


## 1. Rotation sensitivity and limits

Sensitivity and update-max values are per input device (X, Y). Yaw and pitch limits are in degrees; a limit is only enforced when its `bLimit...` flag is true. Rotation speed is the turret slew speed in degrees per second.

`FullSim` (a physically simulated turret with drive strength and damping) is used by the Havoc 30 mm cannon and the four tank main guns (TNK_03, TNK_01 Artillery and Heavy, TNK_04); every other weapon uses a plain rotation speed. Where the minimum yaw is larger than the maximum (STN_01: 90 and -90) the pair is stored in that order and the limit flag is unset; read it as a +/- 90 degree arc (the engine behaviour for an unset flag is not traced).

## 3. Aim cameras

`WeaponStatesCameraData` has one entry per aim state (`State.Vehicle.Weapon.HipFire`, `.ADS`). `Zeroing` is the distance the aim point is aligned to when `bAlignWithTarget` is true; `FOV x` is the field-of-view multiplier of that state.

## 4. Crosshair tables (`DT_VehicleCrosshair_*`)

There are eight `DT_VehicleCrosshair_*` tables. Each is a `DataTable` of `WDUIVehicleCrosshairDataTableRow`: a row per weapon-extension tag, with the widget class that draws the reticle, the view model class, and an unnamed flag. Only the names are listed; the reticle art is out of scope.

| Table | Row (weapon extension tag) | Reticle widget | View model | Unnamed flag |

| `DT_VehicleCrosshair_ROT02` | `Id.Vehicle.WeaponExtension.ROT_02.122mm` | none (default reticle) | `WDUIVehicleCrosshairViewModel` | false |
| `DT_VehicleCrosshair_ROT02` | `Id.Vehicle.WeaponExtension.ROT_02.30mmCannon` | `W_Havoc_Reticle_02_C` | `WDUIVehicleCrosshairViewModel` | false |

| `DT_VehicleCrosshair_STN_05` | `Id.Vehicle.WeaponExtension.STN_05.MainBarrel` | `W_STN_03_Reticle_C` | `WDUIVehicleCrosshairViewModel` | false |

11 rows in 6 tables with rows; the tables `DT_VehicleCrosshair_STN01`, `DT_VehicleCrosshair_STN06` exist but have no rows. 1 row has no widget class and uses the default reticle. All rows use the same view model class and have the unnamed flag false.
